# the same claim where the end had to be DECODED because neither image declares a
# .pdata entry; it additionally carries the relocation check .pdata would have
# stood in for. IDENTICAL-PREFIX is what a truncated comparison says instead of
# lying: streams matched, coverage unknown, nothing accepts it.
# IDENTICAL-LEAF-NOPATCH is an IDENTICAL-LEAF that cannot be hooked: same whole-
# body proof, same decoded extents, same relocation check -- and the body is
# shorter than the five bytes MinHook writes, with MinHook's own ported rules
# refusing the site in both images. er-game-base/build.rs admits it to
# VERIFIED_1162_TO_1170 (CALL and READ) and to NOTHING else. It exists because
# those two decisions used to be one: a three-byte getter was reported
# IDENTICAL-SHORT, which withdrew it from comparing as well as from hooking.
# PATCH-SITE-IDENTICAL is none of those: the two bodies DIFFER, and the
# difference is nowhere near the detour. Both images' .pdata declare a function
# starting at the pair, the comparison covered both bodies in full, MinHook's own
# trampoline walk (ported from vendor/minhook) succeeds at both and consumes the
# same instructions, and every differing instruction lies strictly after the last
# one it relocates -- so the patch overwrites the same prologue and the trampoline
# returns into the same instruction. The difference is additionally capped at a
# localised edit, and any substituted instruction refuses it outright. Re-run
# `verify-rva-map-1170.py <va>` on such a row to see the hunks and the window.
# The entry column is the OTHER half of a detour's licence: whether each image's own
# .pdata declares a function to start at that address. er-game-base/build.rs
# requires BOTH-ENTRIES before a row may carry a detour, because IDENTICAL over a
# body says the code is the same and says nothing about whether MinHook may
# relocate the five bytes it is about to overwrite.
# The extent column shows where each body's end came from and, when the two
# disagree, by how much: PDATA:0x120b/0x1213+8 is a body that GREW, which is
